content:
Greetings, **RozRaid**! 

Here is your comprehensive, tactical roadmap tailored directly to your profile, ongoing goals, and bossing targets.

---

### 📊 Current Strategic Snapshot

| Skill / Profile Feature | Current Level / Status | Target Goal | Progress Summary |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Necromancy** | Level 106 (28.2M XP) | Level 120 (104.2M XP) | ~27% of 120 XP reached |
| **Slayer** | Level 95 (9.2M XP) | 99+ | Synergizes with [Full Slayer Helmet](https://runescape.wiki/w/Full_slayer_helmet) |
| **Necromancy Quests** | 6 Completed | 100% Completion | Key storyline & power unlocks remaining |
| **Favorite Boss Target** | [Kree'arra](https://runescape.wiki/w/Kree%27arra) | Easy AFK / High KPH | Highly weak to Necromancy burst & sustain |

---

### 🎯 Step-by-Step Strategic Plan aligned with your To-Do List

#### 1. 🔮 Necroplasm Conversion (Lesser/Greater ➔ Powerful Necroplasm)
To efficiently process all of your lower-tier necroplasm into **[Powerful Necroplasm](https://runescape.wiki/w/Powerful_necroplasm)**:
* **Ritual Setup**: Run **[Greater Communion](https://runescape.wiki/w/Greater_communion)** rituals or direct transmutation.
* **Glyph Optimization**: Fill optional glyph spots with **[Multiply III](https://runescape.wiki/w/Multiply_III)** glyphs (or highest unlocked Multiply glyphs) to maximize your yield per ritual attempt.
* **Distraction Management**: Actively clear [Ritual Disturbances](https://runescape.wiki/w/Ritual_disturbances) (Defiles, Wandering Souls, Corrupt Glyphs) for bonus experience while processing materials.

---

#### 2. 📜 Completing All Necromancy Quests & Task Unlocks
You have already completed key storyline quests including *Necromancy!*, *Kili Row*, *The Spirit of War*, *Vessel of the Harbinger*, *Tomes of the Warlock*, and *That Old Black Magic*.

* **Next Immediate Goal**: Work toward completing **[Alpha vs Omega](https://runescape.wiki/w/Alpha_vs_Omega)**.
* **Kili’s Knowledge Equipment Upgrades**: Ensure you complete all of Kili's armor/weapon tier upgrade tasks up to Tier 90/95. This will maximize your hit chance and damage output against endgame targets and bossing.
* Review full requirements on the official **[Necromancy Quests Guide](https://runescape.wiki/w/Necromancy_quests)**.

---

#### 3. 💀 Grind to 120 Necromancy (104,273,167 XP Goal)
With 28.2M XP achieved, you have built a massive foundation. To close the gap to Level 120:

* **High-XP Ritual Route**: Setup high-tier rituals using **[Attraction III Glyphs](https://runescape.wiki/w/Attraction_III)** and focus entirely on disturbance events for peak XP/hour.
* **Combat Route (Slayer Synergy)**: Wear your **[Full Slayer Helmet](https://runescape.wiki/w/Full_slayer_helmet)** on active task to stack the **+14.5% boost to damage and accuracy** while training Necromancy on high-density Slayer targets (e.g., [Abyssal Demons](https://runescape.wiki/w/Abyssal_demon) or [Corrupted Creatures](https://runescape.wiki/w/Corrupted_creature)).
* Refer to the official **[Necromancy Training Guide](https://runescape.wiki/w/Necromancy_training)** for optimal gear setups and ability bars.

---

#### 4. 🦅 Bossing Strategy: [Kree'arra](https://runescape.wiki/w/Kree%27arra) with Necromancy
Necromancy trivializes Armadyl's Eyrie:
* **Conjures**: Maintain **[Conjure Undead Army](https://runescape.wiki/w/Conjure_Undead_Army)** (Skeleton Warrior, Putrid Zombie, Conjure Ghost). The **Ghost's Haunt** passive provides continuous passive healing, rendering Kree'arra's ranged/magic attacks negligible.
* **Sustain**: Use **[Blood Siphon](https://runescape.wiki/w/Blood_Siphon)** when minion spawns group up to heal back to full HP instantly without consuming food.
* **Burst Damage**: Use **[Death Skulls](https://runescape.wiki/w/Death_Skulls)** as your primary adrenaline dump to quickly eliminate Kree'arra and bounce between the surrounding bodyguard minions.

---

### 📋 Priority Action Items
1. **Loadout Preparation**: Equip your best Necromancy weapon/gear tier + **[Full Slayer Helmet](https://runescape.wiki/w/Full_slayer_helmet)**.
2. **Ritual Processing**: Perform Powerful Communion rituals utilizing **Multiply Glyphs** to convert your stockpile into Powerful Necroplasm.
3. **Questing**: Complete **[Alpha vs Omega](https://runescape.wiki/w/Alpha_vs_Omega)** and finalize any remaining tier upgrade achievements with Kili.
